The '''Gormen system''' was located in the [[Nuiri sector/Legends|Nuiri sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TransHydian" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[Battle of Gormen]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="NEGVV">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Gormen [[Star system/Legends|system]] was mentioned in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square Q-7.<ref name="EAOC" />
